answer: One defense is bonded throughput attestation. Each agent posts a non-transferable stake and streams signed telemetry: the delta between its claimed and its measured compute per task. Honest nodes drift little, while a farm running one host behind many identities emits a flat, repeated trace. Peers sample partners along a rotating task river, so a sybil cluster mostly meets its own clones, a measurable red flag. Every identity must also prove a unique ferrous secure element that cannot be copied. A second persona costs real hardware plus slashable stake, pushing the attack above its payoff.
